radar.title: Topic radar
radar.lead: What runs on a curated set of channels — a signal for the desk, never content to rewrite.
radar.retention: API numbers live at most {days} days, or they are fetched again every day.
radar.noComments: No comment texts, no user names. The comment count is a public metric of the video.
radar.formula: Normalised to 100: the average of the signals we have (0–20 each), computed from {count} of {total} signals. Three of them work today: performance (views ÷ subscribers), age (half-life 90 days) and relevance (closeness to our topics). Search demand and competition are missing as long as there is no data source for them.
radar.empty: No run yet. The radar fetches its numbers once a day — or at the press of a button.
radar.missingText: Without a key the radar fetches nothing. The server environment needs the line NUXT_INSIGHTS_YOUTUBE_KEY. Only the public figures of the API are then stored per video, for at most {days} days — no comment texts, no user names.
radar.runErrors: one error on the way | one error on the way | {count} errors on the way
radar.rateLimited: Too many runs this hour. Try again shortly.
radar.notConfigured: Without an API key the radar cannot fetch anything.

skipped.not_configured: No API key present — the run fetched nothing.
skipped.no_channels: No channels configured — the run fetched nothing.
skipped.quota_estimate: The run would have been too expensive. The channel list is too long.
skipped.running: One is already running. Wait a moment.
